description: RFC 5322 headers preserved from a bridge-in message to enable threading and audit. Per ADR-2605172200.

messageId.description: Original RFC 5322 Message-ID header value, including angle brackets.

references.description: References header parsed into individual Message-ID values.

receivedChain.description: Ordered list of Received: header hops (closest hop first) for audit. Only hostnames; IPs and timestamps are dropped.

originalFrom.description: Original From: header value as it appeared in the SMTP message.

originalTo.description: Original To: + Cc: header values combined.

subject.description: Original RFC 5322 Subject header (verbatim). Mirrors message.subject but preserved separately for round-trip.
